info.name: LinkForty Core — feature journey
info.description:
Import this collection into Postman or Insomnia (Postman v2.1).

Every request uses {{localbase_url}}. Default is http://localhost:3000 (examples/basic-server.ts and examples/docker-compose.yml).

Run folders from top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Each create request saves ids into collection variables. Later folders read those variables. Do not run Cleanup until you have finished the journey.

Folders 05 Social preview and 11 Debug are real routes, but createServer() does not mount them. Register previewRoutes and debugRoutes yourself before those folders. A 404 there means the plugin is not mounted, not that the URL is wrong.

Read examples/POSTMAN.md for the variable list and what each folder proves.

exec: // Filled once per collection. Clear a variable in the collection editor to mint a new one.

variable.description: Base URL of the LinkForty server. No trailing slash. Change this when you point at another machine.
UUID of the tenant for this journey. Auto-filled on the first request. Pass it as ?userId= on dashboard routes. Must be a UUID.
Saved from POST /api/templates. Used to read, update, set default, delete, and to attach a new link.
Saved from POST /api/templates (field slug). Used by /:templateSlug/:shortCode and the scoped SDK resolve.
Saved from POST /api/links (field id). Used by get, update, QR, analytics, debug simulate, and cleanup.
Saved from POST /api/links (field short_code). Public path of the link. Also sent as customCode on create so the code is stable.
Saved from POST /api/links/:id/duplicate. Deleted in Cleanup. The original link_id stays for the rest of the journey.
Saved from POST /api/webhooks. Used by get, update, test, and cleanup.
Saved from POST /api/webhooks (field secret). The receiver checks HMAC-SHA256 of the body in header X-LinkForty-Signature. List webhooks does not return this.
Where LinkForty POSTs webhook events. httpbin echoes the body so you can see the test delivery. Swap for your own receiver.
Saved from POST /api/sdk/v1/install (field installId). Required by POST /api/sdk/v1/event.
Paste the install_events.fingerprint_hash from the database if you want GET /api/sdk/v1/attribution/:fingerprint. The install response does not return this hash.
Stable device id sent on install (IDFA/GAID stand-in). Auto-filled once.
UUID the app would retry with. Sending the same value twice returns the stored event with duplicate: true. Auto-filled once. Clear it to record a second event.
Analytics window. Query ?days= on overview and per-link stats. Bot clicks are excluded.
Device timezone. Sent on the public click as ?fp_tz= and again in the install body so fingerprint scoring can match.
Device language. Click query fp_lang and install body language. Worth 10 fingerprint points.
Screen width in pixels. Click query fp_sw and install body screenWidth. Together with height, worth 10 points.
Screen height in pixels. Click query fp_sh and install body screenHeight.

item.name: 01 Health
item.description: Proves the process is up, and that PostgreSQL answers. Call these before anything else. Liveness does not touch the database. Readiness returns 503 when PostgreSQL is down. Redis down is degraded, not unready.

request.description: GET /health. Process is up. Response: { status: "ok", uptime }. Does not query PostgreSQL. Docker and Kubernetes liveness probes use this.
GET /health/ready. Database must answer. Response includes checks.database. Redis is reported when configured. Expect 200 when Postgres is up, 503 when it is not.

item.name: 02 Templates
item.description: Reusable defaults for a family of links: store URLs, attribution window, UTM tags, targeting. One template can be the default. The slug lets the public URL be /:templateSlug/:shortCode when the same short code exists on more than one template. Run this folder before Links so {{template_id}} and {{template_slug}} are saved.

request.description: POST /api/templates. Creates a product-link template. Saves id → {{template_id}} and slug → {{template_slug}}. userId must be a UUID. isDefault false here; the next requests mark it default on purpose so you can see that step.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/templates?userId={{user_id}}. Returns only this tenant’s templates, default first. Omit userId to list every template (single-tenant).

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/templates/:id. One template. 404-style error when the id is unknown or belongs to another userId.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: PUT /api/templates/:id. Partial update. Slug does not change. Settings replace the stored settings object.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: PUT /api/templates/:id/set-default. Marks this template as the default and clears is_default on the tenant’s other templates.

item.name: 03 Links
item.description: The short link everything else hangs off. Create uses {{template_id}} when that variable is set, and a stable {{short_code}}. The short code does not change on update. Duplicate makes a second code and saves {{duplicate_link_id}}. Deletes are in folder 12 so analytics and the SDK still have this link.

request.description:
POST /api/links. Campaign link for product 123.

Saves id → {{link_id}} and short_code → {{short_code}}.

The pre-request builds the JSON so templateId is omitted when you have not created a template yet (an empty string is not a valid UUID). It also mints {{short_code}} once and sends it as customCode.

Send attributionWindowHours or attributionWindowMinutes, not both. Hours max 2160 (90 days). Minutes min 5, max 129600. Default window is 168 hours.

appScheme must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*$.

targetingRules on this link allow ios, android, and web, and language en. Country rules are left off: a request from localhost often has no country, and a country list would 404 that click. Add countries such as ["IN","US"] only when the visitor IP resolves to one of them.

exec: description: 'Opens /product/123 in the app, otherwise the store or the website.',
ogDescription: 'Back in stock. Open in the app.',

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/links?userId={{user_id}}. Each row includes clickCount, utmParameters, targetingRules, deepLinkParameters, and template_slug when the link has a template.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/links/:id. One link plus clickCount. userId scopes the lookup to that tenant.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: PUT /api/links/:id. Partial update. short_code stays the same. isActive false stops the public redirect. Do not send both attribution window units.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: POST /api/links/:id/duplicate. Clones the link onto a new short code. Saves that id as {{duplicate_link_id}}. The original {{link_id}} and {{short_code}} are left in place for redirect, QR, analytics, and the SDK.

item.name: 04 Public redirect
item.description: What a person (or a crawler) hits. Follow redirects is OFF so you see the 302 and the Location header instead of the destination site. The click is written in the background, including fingerprint query params, so folder 09 can match an install. Run the iPhone request before SDK install. Targeting that does not match returns 404.

query.description: Fingerprint timezone stored on the click.
Fingerprint language stored on the click.
Fingerprint screen width.
Fingerprint screen height.
Inbound UTM wins over the UTM saved on the link.
Non-reserved query param. Stored as link_params and returned to the app on resolve/install.

request.description: GET /:shortCode as an iPhone. This is the click the later install should match. Same User-Agent, timezone, language, and screen size as the install body. IP match is 40 points and User-Agent match is 30, so those two alone reach the 70-point threshold when Postman and the server see the same client IP. fp_* adds timezone, language, and screen. Expect 302. Location is the app, the store, or the website.

exec: // 302 redirect, 200 launchpad/interstitial HTML, 404 if targeting excludes you

query.description: Fingerprint timezone.
Fingerprint language.

request.description: GET /:shortCode as Android Chrome. Play Store destinations carry lf_click=<click id> in the install referrer. A later install can send that string as installReferrer and match this exact click at confidence 100.

GET /:shortCode as desktop Safari. With webFallbackUrl set, expect a 302 to the website plus UTM tags. With no website, expect the launchpad HTML (store buttons and a QR code). launchpadMode on the link can force the page on or off.

request.description: GET /:shortCode with a Facebook crawler User-Agent. Known bots receive Open Graph HTML (og:title, og:description, og:image) instead of being redirected to the store. Real browsers still redirect.

query.description: Fingerprint timezone stored on the click.

request.description: GET /:templateSlug/:shortCode. Same redirect, limited to links on that template. Use this when two templates share a short code. Needs {{template_slug}} from folder 02.

item.name: 05 Social preview
item.description: GET /:shortCode/preview returns Open Graph HTML for Slack, iMessage, Facebook, and LinkedIn. createServer() does not register previewRoutes. Mount previewRoutes or this folder returns 404. The crawler behavior on GET /:shortCode (folder 04) works without this route.

request.description: GET /:shortCode/preview. HTML with og:title, og:description, and og:image from the link. Meant for crawlers. Requires previewRoutes to be registered.

item.name: 06 QR codes
item.description: PNG or SVG of the short URL. A scan follows the same redirect as a tap. Response is an image, not JSON. format=png|svg, size 128–2048, color and bgcolor are hex.

query.description: png or svg. Default png.
Pixels, clamped to 128–2048. Default 512.
Foreground hex.
Background hex.

request.description: GET /api/links/:id/qr?format=png. Body is image/png. In Postman, use Send and Download, or the visualizer, to see the image.

query.description: Vector QR for print.
Pixels, clamped to 128–2048.

request.description: GET /api/links/:id/qr?format=svg. Body is image/svg+xml.

item.name: 07 Analytics
item.description: Read model over click_events. Run folder 04 first so there is at least one click. ?days= limits the window ({{days}} defaults to 7). Bot clicks are excluded. These routes do not change routing.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.
How many days back. Default on the server is 30 when omitted.

request.description: GET /api/analytics/overview. Totals, unique clicks, and breakdowns by date, country, device, platform, hour, UTM, and referrer, plus topLinks.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.
Window in days.

request.description: GET /api/analytics/links/:linkId. Same shape as the overview, scoped to {{link_id}}.

item.name: 08 Webhooks
item.description: Push click_event, install_event, and conversion_event to another system. The server generates the secret. Payloads are signed HMAC-SHA256 in X-LinkForty-Signature. Failed deliveries are retried. The test request POSTs a sample payload to {{webhook_receiver_url}}.

request.description: POST /api/webhooks. Saves id → {{webhook_id}} and secret → {{webhook_secret}}. events must be one or more of click_event, install_event, conversion_event. retryCount 1–10 (default 3). timeoutMs 1000–60000 (default 10000).

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/webhooks. Secrets are hidden in the list. Use Get webhook to read the secret again.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: GET /api/webhooks/:id. Includes secret. Saves it again into {{webhook_secret}}.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: PUT /api/webhooks/:id. Change name, url, events, isActive, headers, retryCount, or timeoutMs. The secret stays the same.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: POST /api/webhooks/:id/test. LinkForty POSTs a sample event to the webhook URL and returns the delivery result (HTTP status from the receiver, or an error). httpbin.org/post should return success.

item.name: 09 Mobile SDK
item.description: Called by the app, not by the dashboard. Order inside this folder: health, resolve (app already installed), install (app just installed), attribution lookup, in-app event. Resolve also records a click. Install tries to match the iPhone click from folder 04. Event needs {{install_id}}.

request.description: GET /api/sdk/v1/health. SDK connectivity check. Response: { status: "healthy", version: "v1", timestamp }.

query.description: Stored on the click this resolve records.
Stored on the click this resolve records.
Screen width.
Screen height.

request.description: GET /api/sdk/v1/resolve/:shortCode. App is already installed and was opened by the link. Returns deep link JSON: shortCode, linkId, deepLinkPath, appScheme, iosUrl, androidUrl, webUrl, utmParameters, customParameters, clickedAt, isDeferred false. Also writes a click.
GET /api/sdk/v1/resolve/:templateSlug/:shortCode. Same JSON as resolve, scoped to the template. Needs {{template_slug}}.

POST /api/sdk/v1/install. First app open after install. Saves installId → {{install_id}}.

Match order:
1. installReferrer containing lf_click=<click id> matches that click (Android Play referrer). Confidence 100. Leave it empty in this request to exercise fingerprint matching.
2. Otherwise score recent clicks inside the link's attribution window: IP 40, user agent 30, timezone 10, language 10, screen 10. Need 70+.
3. Below 70 the install is organic: attributed false, deepLinkData null.

Use the same user agent and fp_* values as "Open short link as iPhone". The server uses the connection IP, not body.ipAddress, for the score.

Response fields: installId, attributed, confidenceScore, matchedFactors, attributionMethod (install_referrer | fingerprint | none), competingLinks, deepLinkData.

exec: // screenWidth and screenHeight must be numbers. Rebuild from variables so a changed fp_sw is sent as a number.

request.description: Same endpoint, Android path. Set collection variable install_referrer to the lf_click value you saw on a Play Store redirect (lf_click=<uuid>), then send this. attributionMethod should be install_referrer. This request does not overwrite {{install_id}} when you want to keep the fingerprint install; it saves play_install_id instead. Leave install_referrer empty and this body omits the field.

GET /api/sdk/v1/attribution/:fingerprint. Debug or delayed check. Paste install_events.fingerprint_hash into {{fingerprint}}. The install API does not return that hash. 404 with "No install event found" until the variable is a real hash. On a hit: fingerprint, attributed, installEvent, clickEvent, linkData.

POST /api/sdk/v1/event. Something that happened after install: signup, add to cart, purchase.

Needs {{install_id}}. Saves nothing new except you can read eventId in the response.

clientEventId makes retries safe. The collection keeps one UUID in {{client_event_id}}. Send this request twice: the second response has duplicate: true and the same eventId.

Revenue convention: eventName "revenue" and eventData.revenue plus eventData.currency.

Optional last-click fields: attributedLinkId, attributedClickId, linkOpenedAt, sessionId.

item.name: 10 App association files
item.description: Apple and Google fetch these once to allow the domain to open the app without a browser prompt. Without the env vars the server returns 404 and a message naming the missing variables. Taps still work; they go through the browser, the store, or the interstitial.

request.description: GET /.well-known/apple-app-site-association. 200 JSON when IOS_TEAM_ID and IOS_BUNDLE_ID are set. 404 with error "Configuration missing" otherwise. Served as application/json with no .json extension.
GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json. 200 when ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME and ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS are set (comma-separated SHA-256 cert fingerprints). 404 when they are missing.

item.name: 11 Debug
item.description: Dry-run routing and sample fixtures. createServer() does not register debugRoutes. Mount debugRoutes or these return 404. Simulate does not write a click. The live socket is a WebSocket; Postman can open it with New → WebSocket using the URL in that request.

request.description: POST /api/debug/simulate. Answers "where would this device go?" without inserting a click. deviceType ios|android|web. country is a 2-letter ISO code. language is like en or en-IN. ipAddress must be a valid IP if you send it. Requires debugRoutes.
POST /api/debug/simulate for a desktop visitor. Expect redirectReason to mention web_fallback_url when the link has a website.
GET /api/debug/user-agents. iOS, Android, and desktop User-Agent strings you can copy into {{ios_user_agent}}, {{android_user_agent}}, or {{desktop_user_agent}}.
GET /api/debug/countries. ISO country codes for simulate and for targetingRules.countries.
GET /api/debug/languages. Language codes for simulate and for targetingRules.languages.

query.description: Only clicks for this tenant. Omit to see all.
Only clicks on this link. Omit to see all of the user.

request.description: WebSocket /api/debug/live. Not a normal HTTP GET. In Postman choose New → WebSocket and connect to ws://localhost:3000/api/debug/live?userId={{user_id}}&linkId={{link_id}} (replace http with ws, or https with wss). First message is { type: "connected" }. Each real click (folder 04 or SDK resolve) arrives as { type: "click_event", data }. Requires debugRoutes. This HTTP request only documents the path; expect 404 on the default server.

item.name: 12 Cleanup
item.description: Deletes the rows this journey created. Run this last. Order: duplicate link, webhook, template. The original link is deleted last. Deleting the template does not delete links that still point at it; delete links first if you need a clean tenant. Skipping this folder leaves the data in PostgreSQL so you can re-open analytics.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: DELETE /api/links/:id for the clone. Original {{link_id}} remains until the last request in this folder.

exec: // Fails when duplicate_link_id was never saved

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: DELETE /api/webhooks/:id. Stops deliveries. The secret is discarded with the row.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: DELETE /api/templates/:id. Removes the shared defaults. Run after you are done creating links from it.

query.description: Tenant id. Same value for the whole journey so lists only show your rows.

request.description: DELETE /api/links/:id. Removes the campaign link. Public /{{short_code}} 404s after this. Run last.
